parent.r51_original_qualification: full G4/G5/G7 PASS and 7680/7680 decisions both OS; synthetic DEV 2/2 pass, fixed magnitude heuristic ties, Native backbone zero attribution

hypothesis.main: Gradient-trained eligibility for observed action-conditional consequence CONTRAST between two genuinely selected interventions (action 0 versus action 1 on the same public continuous state tag) can suppress misleading high public tags and misleading large action-INVARIANT physical effects, preserving hidden-gate transfer across longer histories.
hypothesis.learned_part: Context-conditioned tag slopes and one salience coefficient multiplying absolute observed action-contrast difference; initialized zero. Paired-action contrast is a fixed public, transparent feature transformation rather than discovered causality.
hypothesis.critical_falsifier: If source-only action-contrast reference errs or gate-paired mean leaks hidden gate, stop before scored model training. If main misses any frozen acceptance condition on either seed, report DEV NO-GO without tuning spent source.
hypothesis.strong_control: Fully trained context-conditioned fixed action-contrast magnitude top-two reader, with same observed selected action pairs and 256 training updates; if it matches or beats learned salience, no independent learned event-discovery superiority.
hypothesis.negative_controls: Raw single-outcome magnitude top-two, highest-tag top-two, and all-pair context contrast without salience, alongside trained GRU and Native backbone necessity ablation
hypothesis.scope: Synthetic evidence cannot establish real-world causal learning, autonomy, retention, AGI or Native substrate benefit.

source.placement: SHA256(salt/panel/group/local pair index) sorted unique positions for cue, decoy, high-tag spurious1, high-tag spurious2; remaining nuisance pairs are low key and small action-invariant effect; source ordering fixed for both gate values.
source.paired_selected_action_protocol: For every observed source pair, execute and record selected action0 consequence and then selected action1 consequence on its own freshly reset identical public state tag. Both selected consequences actually observed; do not simulate unchosen return action. Public state tag on both records, actions explicitly 0/1 in key, measured physical delta in observed effect[0], effect[4] zero.
source.causal_pair_effects: Cue pair action0=+amp*gate, action1=-amp*gate; decoy pair reversed, so paired public B mean cancels gate.
source.spurious_pair_effects: Both selected actions have exactly the same high physical effect for each confounder, independent of hidden gate; these are HIGHER |delta| than the genuine causal return-relevant action-consequence effects.
source.nuisance_pair_effects: Both selected actions same round(amplitude*sin((salt+group)*.137+pair*.271)+.004*((pair+group)%4-1.5),8), independent of hidden gate.
source.fifth: Original R51/R49 four factual early observations and selected fifth probe .42/context; FIT-only fifth calibration, no CAL/OOD calibration or hidden q/gate.
source.return_goal_law: Original R49 quartic FIT/CAL / cubic OOD physical return law with return state (.61,.73) by group parity and squared goal error, no unobserved action result enters input.
source.paired_public_global_mean: Whole 16D selected B mean and selected action-key mean must be exactly equal at fixed context,q,group across opposite hidden gate values; individual causal pair contrasts differ.
source.observable_reference: From public selected action pairs, choose highest two absolute |physical_effect(action0)-physical_effect(action1)|, not highest raw effect or public tag. Tag-role max/min according to public context, multiply FIT-centered fifth; zero errors in 192 FIT+64 CAL+64 OOD worlds required.

methods.optim: AdamW: context slopes, contrast salience and readout gains lr .02; Native/GRU weights lr .001; weight_decay 0; gradient clip norm 1, exact same paired FIT draws and selected consequences per arm.
methods.model: For each pair of genuinely selected action consequences, decode public physical deltas d0,d1 and tag. Signed contrast=(d0-d1)/2; baseline mean=(d0+d1)/2. Main logits=slope[public_context]*public_tag + learned_salience*12*abs(contrast); weights=softmax logits over ALL sources; B causal signal=weighted sum of signed contrasts. Readout uses FIT-centered measured fifth. Salience starts exactly 0 and is learned by real task gradients.
methods.raw_control: Uses the same per-pair signed action contrast and public tags, but no learned contrast salience term; same 3-param context attention.
methods.tag_control: Selects top 2 public tags before context attention and uses measured signed contrasts, cannot see lower-tag cue under confounding.
methods.raw_magnitude_control: Selects top 2 by largest mean(|delta0|,|delta1|), which are the high-magnitude action-independent confounders.
methods.contrast_heuristic_control: Hand-coded top 2 by absolute ACTION DIFFERENCE of selected effects (not labels, private source positions); then trained 2 context slopes/gain. Must be credited if it matches main.
methods.native_control: R34 Native factual-memory backbone with full selected 30/38/46 history adapted LOCALLY, plus learned contrast head and separately ablated original Native backbone, original shared R34 unmodified.
methods.gru_control: Conventional GRU on the same observed public source tag, both selected physical outcomes, context with trained readout, no evaluator metadata; report convergence and input/capacity/compute differences.
record: all action choices by panel and intervention

frozen_score.stronger_science_criterion: A future independent claim requires positive repeatable gains vs frozen fixed action-contrast heuristic and fully competent input/compute-matched conventional, plus independent interference retention and new external first-use authorization.
frozen_score.fail_policy: Preserve negative and ambiguous results unchanged; do not tune after scoring, do not claim Native-specific benefit without nonzero backbone ablation.
